exposure: Percutaneous Seldinger PD catheter placement (new and rigorous technique of SPD)
cohort: The study included the first 64 patients undergoing the new Seldinger PD technique at the unit, many of whom were severely ill with renal failure, unfit for general anesthesia, and moderately to severely obese.
finding: The new and rigorous Seldinger PD catheter placement technique achieved a 97% technical success rate with no procedure-related mortality, organ injury, or significant bleeding, making it safe and precise even in a morbid patient cohort.
